description: Expander for the Programmer, adding nudge and CV controls for its four tracks; it works immediately to the left or immediately to the right of a Programmer

params.text: Nudges that track of the Programmer forward one stage each time it is pressed, so every stage takes the voltage programmed into the stage after it
Nudges that track of the Programmer backward one stage each time it is pressed, so every stage takes the voltage programmed into the stage before it
Nudges all four tracks of the Programmer forward one stage each time it is pressed, so every stage takes the voltage programmed into the stage after it
Nudges all four tracks of the Programmer backward one stage each time it is pressed, so every stage takes the voltage programmed into the stage before it

inputs.text: How many stages each nudge of that track moves, read as semitones: a twelfth of a volt for every stage, so 2 semitones gives 2 stages per nudge
A pulse nudges that track forward
A pulse nudges that track backward
A voltage added to the programmed voltage of that track
How many stages each nudge of all four tracks moves, read as semitones: a twelfth of a volt for every stage, so 2 semitones gives 2 stages per nudge
A pulse nudges all four tracks forward
A pulse nudges all four tracks backward
A voltage added to the programmed voltage of all four tracks
